description: A meeting event in which Jonas encounters Adam, an older manifestation of his own persistent identity, in 1921.
A meeting event in which adult Charlotte holds her infant self in 1971 before leaving her with H. G. Tannhaus.
A disappearance event in which Mads Nielsen vanishes from Adam's world in 1986 after being abducted and used in the time travel experiments conducted in the Doppler bunker.
Jonas and Martha meet in the interworld space between Adam's world and Eva's world before preventing the origin event.
A meeting event in which Adult Helge collides with the car driven by Old Helge, who is attempting to kill his younger self in order to stop Noah.
A meeting event in which adult Helge encounters his young child self inside the Doppler bunker in 1986.
A meeting event in which young Jonas encounters his adult self (The Stranger) while locked in the bunker in 1986.
A meeting event in which adult Claudia meets her elderly self (Old Claudia) in 1987 and receives instructions about time travels.
An apocalypse event occurring in Eva's world in 2019.
A disappearance event in which Erik Obendorf vanishes from Adam's world in 2019 after being abducted and taken to the Doppler bunker.
A disappearance event representing Mikkel Nielsen's disappearance from his original temporal and narrative context in 2019.
A disappearance event in which Yasin Friese vanishes from Adam's world in 2019 after being abducted by Noah and Helge.
A dinner meeting in the origin world after the disappearance of Adam's and Eva's worlds.
Jonas meets his father Michael shortly before Michael's suicide.
A meeting event in which young Martha encounters Eva, the elderly manifestation of her own persistent identity, in Erit Lux headquarters.
An apocalypse event occurring in Adam's world in 2020.
